column1: These are AI-generated, non-product assets for Instagram highlight covers. There are two variants of each design; both remain pending owner review, and only one variant per design should be retained after approval. The proposed filenames follow {slug}-{tag}-{n}.png. The tag is descriptive rather than a SKU because these are not product photos.

Use lowercase kebab-case slugs. Keep slugs unique. Use a descriptive non-product tag, here 'ig-highlight'. Start the sequential number at 1 for each slug+tag combination. Do not assign product SKUs to these assets.
